_comment: Mutation testing answers the question coverage cannot: would the tests notice if the code were wrong? Scoped to pure logic — mutating DOM-bound game classes is slow and mostly yields equivalent mutants. Never runs in the pre-commit hook or the PR gate; see .github/workflows/quality.yml.
_thresholds_comment: break is set below the measured baseline (97.54% on 2026-08-25) so the scheduled job fails on a real regression, not on the noise of a mutant or two. A single mutant is worth ~0.36 points here, so the ~5.5-point cushion is about 15 mutants. Ratcheted 80 -> 87 -> 92 as the baseline moved; each step measured and rounded down, never above a baseline. The backlog is closed: all seven remaining survivors are equivalent mutants, listed by name in docs/SUITE-HEALTH.md, so the score is at its ceiling. A drop is a regression, not an opportunity.
